_schema_note: This template must be completed by a human authorizer. Software must never populate human approval fields or set authorization_status to APPROVED. All HUMAN_REQUIRED values must be replaced by a named human using actual current package evidence before any non-dry-run training can be considered.
readiness_package_commit: HUMAN_REQUIRED — full 40-character current artifact-release commit; artifact-source, short, stale, malformed, and unrelated commits are rejected
approved_model_id: HUMAN_REQUIRED — exact approved model identifier, for example Qwen/Qwen3-4B
maximum_budget_usd: HUMAN_REQUIRED — numeric maximum approved spend; must equal approved_compute_environment.approved_cost_ceiling_usd

approved_training_configuration.path: HUMAN_REQUIRED — absolute canonical resolved path to the approved YAML configuration
approved_training_configuration.sha256: HUMAN_REQUIRED — SHA-256 of the exact resolved configuration bytes

approved_compute_environment.gpu_model: HUMAN_REQUIRED — normalized GPU model, or null only for cpu
approved_compute_environment.provider: HUMAN_REQUIRED — null for local; normalized provider required for cloud
approved_compute_environment.region: HUMAN_REQUIRED — null for local; normalized region required for cloud
approved_compute_environment.approved_cost_ceiling_usd: HUMAN_REQUIRED — numeric, exactly equal to maximum_budget_usd

approved_readiness.authorization_binding_sha256: HUMAN_REQUIRED — canonical authorization binding excluding this field
approved_readiness.exit_code: HUMAN_REQUIRED — must be integer 0; exits 1, 2, and 3 block training

approved_by: HUMAN_REQUIRED — full name of the human authorizer
authorization_status: HUMAN_REQUIRED — must be APPROVED; software must never set this
signature_or_typed_confirmation: HUMAN_REQUIRED — typed human confirmation of approved model, exact config hash, compute environment, release commit, and budget
_software_prohibition: SOFTWARE MUST NEVER populate approval, review, legal, authorization, signature, configuration-approval, compute-approval, or readiness-approval fields. A missing or incomplete artifact is default-deny.
